blurb: This check verifies that AIX protects information at rest with the Encrypted File System: the clic.rte fileset is installed and the required filesystem reports EFS enabled. Whether the organization requires data-at-rest encryption, and which filesystems are in scope, is a site/ISSO determination the check does not auto-decide; a missing required filesystem, a failed probe, or an unparseable EFS flag refuses with a typed not-assessed.
